profile.headline: Android @ Walmart
profile.summary: I’m a native Android and iOS developer who turns complex ideas into polished, production-ready mobile apps. I build performant features, optimize existing codebases, and drive UI/UX improvements that increase reliability, speed, and user satisfaction. My focus is delivering mobile solutions that scale, reduce friction, and create measurable impact for businesses and their users.

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
- Improved multiple core features and bug fixes, stability improvements, and performance optimizations.
- Contributed to the optimization of the "Event Page", resulting in a 80% decrease in loading time and a major reduction in WebSocket subscriptions by limiting them to only user relevant data. This improvement positively impacted nearly 1 million active users and counting.
- Delivered a similar large-scale performance upgrade for Competition Pages, which was pending release at the time of departure but expected to have equivalent user and company benefits.

positions.title: Android Engineer
positions.description:
Developed new features, fixed bugs, improved application performance with fully tested code to check and keep existing and new functionality using Kotlin.
- Collaborated with quality developers and an excellent QA team to ensure quality in all stages of a new release.
- Planned, managed, and cleared sprinted tasks in an Agile framework provided by JIRA.
- Started SDKs on top of the current codebase to provide native libraries to other developers around the world.

projects.title: Festello
projects.description:
Fully native Android (Jetpack Compose) and iOS (SwiftUI) applications used by Latin dance festivals to
manage workshop schedules, artists, notifications, and attendees’ overall experience. It includes real-time notifications, offline capabilities (in development), and a performant UI/UX.
Scalable backend using Supabase (Postgres, Edge Functions, Auth, Storage), Firebase (Crashlytics, FCM, Remote Config), Mixpanel for advanced analytics, behavior tracking, and organizer insights.
So far, I've onboarded 8 festival organizers in the first 6 months, used by ~600 dancers, with over 33.5k workshop views, 2.6K workshop bookmarks, and 6.2K artist views.

projects.title: Vive Dance X
projects.description:
- Developed a secured RESTful API using Firebase Cloud Functions to keep consistency across Android and iOS platforms. Implemented Trello’s API to receive and organize feedback from users as well as Google Places API to let users search for venues and cities they would like to visit and dance.
- Developed an Android application using Clean Architecture, MVVM design pattern, ViewModels, LiveData, Coroutines, DataStore, Databinding, and Retrofit.
- Developed an iOS application using MVVM design pattern, Alamofire to communicate with the internal API, re-authenticate and reload JWT and AppCheck tokens provided by Firebase, UIKit to build UI programmatically. Currently migrating all codebase to SwiftUI and async/await asynchronous network calls.
